kind: Executed S0 frame-supported two-foot/two-coupon contact oracle study
scope: Synthetic homogeneous small-strain coupons; not a free quadruped gait, empirical soil calibration, motor energy, or hardware result.

counts.counting: 72 deterministic contexts, not 6048 independent experiments; policy evaluations reuse reference trajectories.

config.purpose: Planned S0 complete compatible-contact and oracle-value experiment after the frozen third R2 campaign. This file is not an executed result.
config.implementation_status: Entry point and S0 orchestration still need implementation; reuse existing TM02 constitutive and deployment solvers.

execution.resume: Reuse completed physical candidate trajectories; resume only unfinished work. Do not rerun R1 or any R2 campaign.

base.inherit: Same Table 1 parameters, Eq.29 interpretation, tensor shear convention and nonlinear viscosity. Reuse selected potentials with their own saved normalization, not the auxiliary RNN.

scientific_questions: At declared force, area and thickness scales, does persistent material history change the useful current action under identical future hind-foot and return requirements?
How much value comes from accounting for future contacts beyond a myopic planner with the same true current material state?
Do frozen ideal/noisy prediction errors change the selected action and its actual outcome in a continuously evolving reference environment?

physical_scope.apparatus: Frame-supported two force-controlled feet/plungers; no free-body gravity balance, locomotion dynamics, traction or terrain flow is claimed.
physical_scope.samples: Two independent homogeneous small-strain coupons with free lateral stress, fixed in world coordinates. This is not a calibrated wet-grass, sand, snow or mud model.
physical_scope.material_normal_axis: Local tensor component 11 is normal to the sample; world x is lateral pad position.

scaling.definition: psi_scaled=gamma*psi and phi_scaled=gamma*phi; preserve the full strain/state evolution at correspondingly scaled stress.
scaling.preferred_implementation: Integrate unchanged reference/learned potentials at sigma_equivalent_MPa=sigma_physical_MPa/gamma. Strain and q are unchanged; physical stress, energy density and dissipation density are multiplied by gamma.
scaling.direct_parameter_alternative: Multiply K_eq, G_eq, K_ov, G_ov, eta_K, eta_D and a_MPa by gamma; leave b and o unchanged. Do not scale only the moduli or omit a_MPa.
scaling.learned_weights_and_norm: Unmodified; this transformation is a declared synthetic-material assumption, not empirical validation on a new material.
scaling.equilibrium_displacement_note: At gamma=0.025, 50/100/150 N correspond to original 2/4/6 MPa and equilibrium compression 0.133333/0.266667/0.400000 mm; at gamma=1, 3.333333/6.666667/10 micrometres. Actual candidate feasibility uses the entire computed history.

contact.control: Ideal prescribed nonnegative normal force; solve compatible material strain and state, then derive contact-foot height.
contact.stress_physical_MPa: sigma11=-normal_force_N/(area_m2*1e6); other five stress components are zero.
contact.compression_m: delta=-thickness_m*epsilon11; surface_z=-delta with virgin surface at z=0.
contact.unilateral: gap>=0, normal_force>=0, gap*normal_force=0. Contact-foot motion follows the material solution; flight is nonpenetrating.
contact.off_contact: Zero external stress on that pad and continuously evolving free recovery. Never clamp strain to zero or add an independent supporting ground reaction.
contact.work: W_plus=sum over pads integral max(normal_force_N*d(delta)/dt,0) dt in the remaining task. Also retain signed contact work. This is not motor electrical energy.
contact.kinematics: Front begins the decision at midpoint flight height; hind begins above P. Generate continuous position trajectories. Use 0.25 s approach, containing <=0.10 s horizontal motion, >=0.12 s lowering and slack; optional waiting occurs in flight before final lowering. Current-to-hind handoff is 0.25 s. Front P-to-Q flight needs at most 0.12+0.20+0.12=0.44 s, available during handoff+hind window+return gap. The 1 mm compression bound is not total actuator travel.
contact.infeasibility: Record full-history physical violations and actual numerical failures with phase/time; do not clip a trajectory, discard a condition, inject fallback support, or relabel it as successful.

context_grid.interpretation: Deterministic mechanism grid, not 72 independent random trials. Prefix/return gaps start after the full 1 s windows; actual zero-load recovery also includes the early waveform's final 0.5 s and other interposed events.

waveforms.equality: Current early/late have identical peak, impulse and 1 s window; only timing differs.

current_candidates.id_order: Enumerate pad P,Q then waveform early,late then wait 0,0.5,1.5; save that integer ID before evaluation.
current_candidates.future_requirements: Hind P and return Q load pair and return gap are fixed by context and identical across all 12 candidates.

task.initial_state: Both pads start virgin at the beginning of the full prefix. Each predictor independently executes the observable prefix.

sequence.motion: After unloading at 0.5 s, front lifts and returns to midpoint flight height within the remaining 0.5 s.
Front lifts; hind descends to P.

task.state_continuity: For each pad build one global time axis spanning prefix through final recovery, with zero stress whenever that pad is unloaded, and integrate continuously. Existing Reference.path and integrate start at q=0 per invocation: do not concatenate separately initialized contact calls. Explicit state continuation is an equivalent implementation.
task.observation_information: Every learned predictor receives the same full observable prefix and future force/time/geometry commands. It evolves its own state, without reference-q injection.
task.time_metric: T=3.5+return_gap_after_hind_window_s+extra_wait_s from decision start to end of return window. Exclude past prefix/gap and post-task 2 s.
task.past_prefix: Preserve for material state and complete plots; do not score its already-incurred compression or work as a consequence of the current decision.

predictors.role: Actual continuously evolving plant and full-horizon oracle.
predictors.state: Continuous on both pads through prefix/current/hind/return/recovery.

predictors.role: Planning-only memory-removal ablation, not the sole strong comparator.
predictors.state: During this predictor's forecast only, initialize a pad to virgin equilibrium immediately before each prescribed contact window; otherwise integrate its free recovery. Preserve and mark those intentional reset events.
predictors.actual_evaluation: Never reset the true reference plant; evaluate its chosen action using reference_continuous's complete candidate trajectory.

predictors.state: Own continuous state from the full observable prefix; no true-q input.
predictors.normalization: Reuse all saved norm fields unchanged; scale physical potentials outside the trained model.

evaluation.remaining_interval: From decision start through the end of the return window.
evaluation.pareto_scope: Retain every feasible candidate and all dominated/infeasible records separately; use the same declared units. Report Pareto sets per predictor and actual consequences in the reference.
evaluation.peak_definition: Maximum max(0,delta) over both pads during the remaining interval; additionally retain separate current-contact and hind/return-contact peaks.
evaluation.full_horizon_selection: Among candidates allowed by wait budget and predicted feasible through the entire remaining task, minimize max_remaining_pad_compression_m. Candidates within the absolute compression tie tolerance of the minimum are a near-tie set; break ties by smaller completion time, then smaller positive work, then fixed candidate ID.
evaluation.failure_selection: No predicted-feasible candidate means no selected action, recorded as a decision failure; no silent fallback.
evaluation.actual_policy_evaluation: Map selected candidate IDs to already computed reference_continuous outcomes, including physical failures. Report true compression regret at matched time allowance, time, work and failure counts; do not infer gain from ranking alone.
evaluation.myopic_oracle: Derived without extra integration from reference_continuous current segments. Has the same true current state, candidate actions and time allowance, but selects only by current-contact peak compression, time through current-window completion, positive work through that completion, then fixed ID. Apply the same compression near-tie rule. Check only current-segment physical feasibility plus common deterministic deadline; do not filter using future true feasibility. Evaluate its entire selected task in the continuous reference.
evaluation.constant_controls: Report all 12 fixed candidate IDs. Also report an explicitly retrospective optimistic constant per gamma and time allowance: require one ID to be feasible in all corresponding 36 contexts, choose minimum mean remaining peak compression, then mean T, then mean W_plus, then ID. Apply the same compression near-tie tolerance to the mean. If none is feasible in all contexts, report none and all constants' completion counts. Never choose a different constant ID per context, and do not call this held-out generalization.
evaluation.history_matched_comparison: Hold gamma, future load pair and return gap fixed; compare changes in prefix pad and prefix gap. Show both action changes and absolute physical consequence changes.
evaluation.noise_scope: Three frozen B models reflect independent training-label noise realizations; no additional observation noise or real sensor robustness is claimed.

budget.counting: Each complete prediction includes two pad histories, full prefix and tail. Time-budget selection, myopic and constants reuse these trajectories; they are not extra independent physical experiments.

required: Actual command, code/config version, frozen model source hashes and computation time in one concise result index.
All context/candidate definitions and global event times; complete time/force/stress/strain/q/delta/foot-trajectory arrays for both pads, or actual failure trajectory.
Compact CSV of every candidate's feasibility, current/future peaks, T and signed/positive contact work; Pareto membership.
CSV of chosen actions, actual continuous-reference consequences, matched regret, myopic/constant comparisons and all failure counts.
Representative fixed-context complete curves and aggregate comparisons; at least one complete front-hind-return animation with actual mm/N/s and explicit deformation magnification.
outputs.representative_contexts: Use both gamma values, both prefix pads, prefix gap 0.1 s, future loads (50,150) N and return gap 0.5 s as the fixed core examples; retain negative cases and reference full/myopic/fixed comparisons. Additional figures only if they explain an actual distinct finding.

delivery.large_new_arrays_and_video: Upload once directly from the execution host to a GitHub Release; include actual URLs and file digests in the result index.
delivery.existing_weights: Reference the original Release and pinned hashes; do not include a second copy in the new result bundle.
delivery.verification: Use already computed local upload-file hash plus GitHub asset size/digest; do not download the full published archive again for redundant verification.
delivery.execution_host_outputs: Keep normal computation output and checkpoints needed for continuation. Required missing model inputs may be fetched on the execution host for computation; do not create a post-publication second archive on the user's computer.

completion.honest_negative_result: If full-state oracle gives constant actions or only tiny physical improvements, complete and publish that result. Do not soften material further, shrink constraints/tie tolerances, tune reward weights, select only favorable contexts or expand the budget to manufacture value.
completion.next_step: Use actual effect size and contact constraints to judge S1 whole-robot relevance. Integration-consistent training is only a later targeted mechanism comparison if task-relevant noisy errors justify it.

base_numerics.integration: implicit Euler, Newton-Raphson with residual-merit backtracking; no time subdivision or alternate solver
base_numerics.shear_convention: tensor components; tensor gradients divide shear derivatives by 2

physical_mapping.gamma_0025: Declared synthetic scaling psi*=gamma psi and phi*=gamma phi; integrate original sigma/gamma without changing weights or normalization.
physical_mapping.material_state: Own full observed-prefix state; continuous both pads including unloaded recovery. Reset only in the explicitly marked planning ablation.
physical_mapping.motion: Continuous piecewise-linear travel; 0.12 s raising/lowering, horizontal travel at <=0.5 m/s. Flight clearance is checked during clear flight/parking, with nonpenetration also checked during transitions.

observed_conclusions: All 864 reference candidates satisfy the declared contact/motion limits; there is no success-rate advantage in this grid.

Full-horizon choices vary with history and future demands. Their physical peak-compression advantage over myopic and a single constant is quantified with its actual time/work cost in oracle-scale-effects.csv.
The original-scale effects are sub-micrometre. Synthetic gamma=0.025 increases the observed effect but does not establish real terrain or quadruped locomotion benefit.
The frozen noisy models retain substantial response bias while much of it is common across actions; material prediction error is not itself decision regret.
This fixed S0 budget is complete. No further softening, expanded experiment, new training, RL, or hardware activation was performed.
retrospective_constant_scope: One single ID per gamma and wait budget over all 36 corresponding contexts; chosen retrospectively, optimistic descriptive comparison, no held-out generalization.

trajectory_schema.q: Each predictor own constitutive internal strain state; never injected from reference.
trajectory_schema.work: Trapezoidal force times material compression increments; positive increments summed separately, past prefix and final 2 s excluded from objectives.

animation.display: Downward displacement below virgin surface is magnified x20; actual mm/N/s are shown at every frame.

publication.contents: All 6048 complete two-pad time series and per-candidate continuation records; event catalog, run provenance and environment lock. Video is a separate asset. No existing R2 weights included.

figure_review: Seven quantitative figures and beginning/middle/end animation frames inspected; actual mm/N/s and deformation x20 versus flight x1 are visible. H.264 1440x864, 179 frames, 7.16 s video covering global t=0..7.10 s.
